source: Reduced factual notes from this acceptance session's tool results; not a fabricated raw runtime response

initialObservation.reason: Same Host PID as the historical evidence, with a start time before the historical product was created

nonProductFailures: First inline UIAutomation probe had a PowerShell pipeline syntax error (exit 1); corrected the test command only.

First screen-coordinate capture failed to acquire the intended foreground window; the invalid capture was discarded and removed. Subsequent captures use target-only PrintWindow; key/click input is refused unless the expected native window is foreground.

The account menu exposes ExpandCollapsePattern, not InvokePattern. Product selection and theme controls expose TogglePattern. Unsupported-pattern, missing-target and disabled-element attempts stopped without falling back to blind input; the helper was adjusted to the actual patterns.
Early theme captures were taken while data was still loading; they were not used as proof of loaded editor usability. Later explicit readiness checks and new screenshots provide that evidence.
On continuation the old PIDs were absent; discovered the new application and Host PIDs instead of assuming continuity.
PowerShell reported HTTP401 as a WebException in the first anonymous Web probe; the later structured Fetch probe records the expected 401 statuses without treating them as plugin failures.

testScope.nativeDesktop: Actual Electron window via Windows UI Automation and target-only PrintWindow, plus foreground-guarded keyboard input
testScope.web: No authenticated controllable browser target obtained. Chrome launch and anonymous HTTP probes are NOT Web DOM E2E.
testScope.concurrency: Real DSH Service/Gateway and durable JSON CAS passed in an isolated single-Host storage root. Existing React conflict test uses a mocked callback. Neither proves a two-real-client UI conflict flow.
testScope.github: Official DSH CLI runCli in an isolated home; fixed Git commit; no live-profile reinstall, no server. Downloaded package loaded in real Cordis/DSH storage/Gateway components.

warnings: GitHub installation logged a slow download warning and an ignored-build-scripts warning; exit 0 and installed runtime entrypoints subsequently loaded successfully.
PowerShell's NativeCommandError formatting around normal DSH CLI stderr did not change the native installation exit code (0).
Regression uses the existing node_modules junction into the ignored local DSH dependency copy; this is not a newly provisioned clean-machine regression.
